notes:
Summary: OrchidStream is a mid-market fintech support platform with ~400 agents across NA/EU. Primary goal: real-time agent assist (streaming suggestions) to reduce Average Handle Time and errors for financial dispute workflows. They also want ticket summarization and safe tool-calling into Zendesk/Backoffice.

Detailed requirements / highlights:
- Latency SLOs: median suggestion RTT < 80ms, P95 < 140ms, P99 < 200ms under normal load; must maintain P95 < 250ms during 3x traffic spikes (billing events). Explicit: <100ms end-to-end ideal for agent UX.
- Throughput: 400 concurrent active agents normally, target POC to validate 2k concurrent (spike) with autoscaling/fallback.
- Streaming: websocket-based token stream with immediate partial suggestions; support server-side prefix caching to reduce repeated context cost.
- Guardrails: allowlist/denylist for tool-calls; require pre-approve macros and UI confirmation before any take-action (no auto-apply). Audit trail for every tool call (user id, model id, prompt hash).
- Tool-calling: integrate with Zendesk, internal CRM, and a payments reconciliation microservice (needs idempotency checks). Prefer explicit function/tool schema and retry semantics.
- Model preferences: open LLMs OK, but must support quantized performance variants; want fallback tiering (fast small model for suggestions, larger model for summarization/QA).
- Cost sensitivity: careful around per-token costs for long context history; interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching, KV cache, and quantization.
- Compliance: data residency for EU customers, retention controls, and ability to disable telemetry for regulated queues.

Stated quotes/remarks from stakeholders:
- "We need suggestions to feel instantaneous or agents will ignore them." — Head of CX
- "Any automatic tool call must be gated; legal will not approve blind writes to refunds." — VP Ops

POC plan (agreed):
- 48-hour dedicated POC: measure median/P95/P99 streaming RTT, validate prefix KV cache for repeated dialogs, test tool-calling allowlist and audit log entries.
- Provide sample transcripts, 3 canonical dispute flows, and a short prompt-suite for quality checks.
- Redwood to deliver a pricing estimate for 1-year reserved Dedicated with burst capacity and private control plane.
